# Textarea { #anylumino.Textarea }

```python
Textarea(
    value='',
    description='',
    placeholder='',
    disabled=False,
    continuous_update=True,
    layout=None,
    style=None,
    rows=None,
)
```

Multiline text input control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name              | Type     | Description                                                           | Default    |
|-------------------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| value | optional | Initial value and synced Python value. | `''` |
| description | optional | Label shown next to the control. | `''` |
| placeholder | optional | Text shown while the input is empty. | `''` |
| disabled | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled. | `False` |
| continuous_update | optional | Whether Python receives updates while the user is typing or dragging. | `True` |
| layout | optional | ipywidgets ``Layout`` object for CSS sizing and spacing. | `None` |
| style | optional | ipywidgets style object or style dictionary. | `None` |
| rows | optional | Visible row count. | `None` |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [continuous_update](#anylumino.Textarea.continuous_update) | Update the value as the user types. If False, update on submission, e.g., pressing Enter or navigating away. |
| [disabled](#anylumino.Textarea.disabled) | Enable or disable user changes |
| [rows](#anylumino.Textarea.rows) | The number of rows to display. |
| [style](#anylumino.Textarea.style) | An instance trait which coerces a dict to an instance. |
